cases.description: Two distinct Vision meetings on same LocalDate; origin across DST; completion at 48 h and 48 h+1 ms; due day end differs; manual task, waived soft-deleted generated task, absent post launch source. Frozen asOf with pending23h, pending48h, success2h, success48h, future actual origin/completion, pre-origin completion, late recorded historical valid completion, waived origin and retired genuine originating meeting. Two Persons: one originating typed administrative completion at2h with no contacted outcome, another open obligation24h; plain completed checkbox/provider acceptance without typed human outcome.

checks: Distinct obligation identities, elapsed boundary independent from due day, task and actual contact reported separately, waiver gives no success and cannot regenerate, unsupported post launch measurement Unknown. Pending23h excluded; pending48h measured miss; valid inclusive2h/48h successes count early. Future/pre-origin actual evidence excluded; late storage/recording alone never invalidates genuine history. Waiver separately excluded; retirement retains origin/performed history. Typed admin2h earns task-fulfillment timeliness only; open24h not yet denominator-eligible. Neither provider acceptance nor plain checkbox supplies typed/contact evidence; contact remains Unknown without supported contacted occurrence.
